name: Immunity Elixir
description: Once again, this potion varies depending on the berry used to protect against status ailments, but like the Shielding Elixir, it's just a variation on the final tempature it is cooked at.
effect: Grants Status Immunity to the Corresponding Status of the Berry used in the Creation of this Elixir. Heals 3 HP and cannot be Heal Blocked for the rest of the scene. 2 Turn Cooldown.
recipes: 500 Poke, 1 Status Immunity Berry, 2 Sitrues Berries, 1 Leppa Berry.
